note: Derived from the draft text alone. Not a wire format. Each vector input is a JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) against base_profile and base_frozen; see README.md.

identifier.uniqueness_scope: one issuer deployment for the lifetime of the evidence store
identifier.reuse_rule: never reused; a second issuer record with the same identifier and a different content digest is SUBSTITUTION (Section 9.1)

attempts.rule: every emission carries attempt_id; observations of different attempt_id values are never merged

base_profile.observer_verification: observer identity and authority come only from the frozen trust configuration (trust.observers); labels inside a record are never trusted

time.ordering_mechanism: trusted-timestamp bases listed in trusted_bases, or one observer's own clock for its own records

control_activation.in_flight_rule: an operation that crossed provider entry before activation keeps that crossing; a later provider-entry attempt may be refused

base_frozen.issuer_inclusion_rule: every instruction with an issuer record (emission at issuer-egress, or a recorded emission failure) whose time lies in the window

set-1.closure_basis: deployment configuration snapshot frozen before the cutoff
set-1.coverage_basis: relying-party inventory of egress paths, accepted under the trust model
